Thanks — Kelsey

Subject: Fwd: Short-term specialty accelerator top-up + hold request — recommended concession

Folks — forwarding HelioMetrix request and Chloe's draft. TL;DR and my recommended approval terms below:

Summary of ask:
- 4-week transient H100-equivalent top-up (18k H100-equivalent GPU hours) starting Jun 10
- Reservation hold (no preemption) for the 4-week window
- Blended overage rate requested for any usage outside the reserve

Commercial recommendation (what we can offer without materially increasing runway risk):
1) 28-day bridge addendum that earmarks the H100-equivalent pool and places a soft reservation hold (ops to prioritize during the window; hard preemption protection not feasible, ops will provide best-effort non-preempt).
2) Blended overage rate at 1.15x standard H100 list overage (applies only to the burst hours outside the committed top-up).
3) One-time usage credit of $12,500 applied to Jun invoice to offset procurement friction (credit contingent on DocuSign of addendum within 5 business days).
4) No change to the base Dedicated contract; this is a limited addendum with explicit start/end and a post-window reconciliation.

Why this is reasonable: preserves unit economics, keeps the long-term Dedicated pricing intact, and provides procurement with predictable cap. I’ve run the numbers against our margin model — this concession is within exec discretionary bounds if approved.

Requested approvals: Lauren to sign off on the blended rate/credit. Markus to confirm ops feasibility and escalate any hard-limit concerns. Chloe to finalize the addendum and send to HelioMetrix for signature.

Karthik
Senior Dir., Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Thanks team — I reviewed Karthik's recommendation and approve the concession with these conditions:

1) Approve blended overage at 1.10x (slightly better to the customer than proposed) for burst hours only, capped at 30% of the requested top-up volume. Any further excess reverts to standard overage.
2) Approve the $12,500 one-time credit, payable only if the addendum is fully executed within 5 business days and HelioMetrix remains current on the last two invoices.
3) Ops must produce a short runbook note on the reservation hold behavior (best-effort non-preempt, and if preemption occurs we auto-failover to cross-region fallback). Markus to confirm and attach runbook text to the addendum.
4) Legal to run a 24-hour review on the addendum; Chloe to route to legal with a narrow scope request.

Chloe — you have approval to proceed with the addendum text and customer send, subject to the above. Please include the HubSpot deal link in the final DocuSign packet.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
